display.name: Attio
display.summary: Searches, reads, and updates Attio records, notes, tasks, and list entries for the signed-in account.
examples: Log a note on the Acme company.
What tasks are due this week?

agent.name: attio
agent.description: Searches and updates the Attio workspace the signed-in account can see: records, lists, notes, tasks, comments, meetings, and emails. A question about an Attio person, company, or deal belongs here.
agent.owns:
You own this Attio workspace: its records, lists, notes, tasks, comments, meetings, and emails. You can search, read, create, and update. You cannot delete a comment or a task, and you cannot merge records.

Search or list first, then get the record, note, or recording, then create or update.

You do not own HubSpot or Close.

tool_descriptions.list-objects: List all objects in the workspace (e.g. companies, people, deals), with optional fuzzy search by name or API slug
tool_descriptions.search-records: Full-text search for records (people, companies, deals, etc.) by name, email, domain, or other indexed attributes. Then read the records with get-records-by-ids.
tool_descriptions.list-records: List records in a given object with optional filtering and sorting
tool_descriptions.get-records-by-ids: Retrieve full details for specific records by their IDs
tool_descriptions.create-record: Create a new record (person, company, deal, or custom object)
tool_descriptions.upsert-record: Create or update a record using a matching attribute (e.g., email or domain)
tool_descriptions.update-record: Update an existing record by record_id
tool_descriptions.list-attribute-definitions: List all attributes available on an object type, including their types and valid options
tool_descriptions.list-activities: List all activities in the workspace, with optional fuzzy search by name or API slug
tool_descriptions.list-activity-attribute-definitions: List the attributes available on an activity, including their types and valid options
tool_descriptions.list-activity-records: List records of a given activity with optional filtering and sorting
tool_descriptions.create-activity-record: Create a new record for an activity
tool_descriptions.update-activity-record: Update an existing activity record by record_id
tool_descriptions.upsert-activity-record: Create or update an activity record using a unique matching attribute, such as an ID from your own system
tool_descriptions.list-lists: List all lists in the workspace, with optional filtering by name or slug
tool_descriptions.create-list: Create a new list to group and track records of a single object type
tool_descriptions.list-list-attribute-definitions: List the available entry attributes for a given list, including their types and options
tool_descriptions.list-records-in-list: List entries in a given list with optional filtering and sorting, including their parent records
tool_descriptions.add-record-to-list: Add a record to a list as a new list entry
tool_descriptions.update-list: Update a list's name, API slug, or permissions
tool_descriptions.update-list-entry-by-id: Update an existing list entry when you already know the entry_id
tool_descriptions.update-list-entry-by-record-id: Find and update a list entry using its parent record ID. This tool errors if the record has zero or multiple entries in the target list.
tool_descriptions.create-comment: Create a new comment on a record, list entry, or as a reply to an existing comment thread
tool_descriptions.list-comments: List comments on a record or list entry, with paginated top-level comments and inline replies
tool_descriptions.list-comment-replies: Fetch additional replies for a top-level comment thread
tool_descriptions.create-note: Create a new note attached to a record
tool_descriptions.search-notes-by-metadata: Search notes by parent record, author, meeting, or creation time. Then read a note with get-note-body.
tool_descriptions.semantic-search-notes: Find notes by topic using AI-powered semantic search. Then read a note with get-note-body.
tool_descriptions.get-note-body: Retrieve the full content of a specific note
tool_descriptions.update-note: Append or prepend content to a note, or update its title
tool_descriptions.list-tasks: List tasks in the workspace with optional filters
tool_descriptions.create-task: Create a new task with optional deadline, assignee, and linked record
tool_descriptions.update-task: Update a task's deadline, status, assignee, or linked record
tool_descriptions.search-meetings: Search past and upcoming meetings by participants, related records, or time range. Then read the record, note, or recording this returns.
tool_descriptions.search-call-recordings-by-metadata: Search call recordings by participants, related records, title, or time range. Then read a recording with get-call-recording.
tool_descriptions.semantic-search-call-recordings: Find call recordings by topic using AI-powered semantic search. Then read a recording with get-call-recording.
tool_descriptions.get-call-recording: Retrieve full details and transcript of a specific call recording
tool_descriptions.search-emails-by-metadata: Search emails by participants, domain, or time range. Then read an email with get-email-content.
tool_descriptions.semantic-search-emails: Find emails by topic using AI-powered semantic search. Then read an email with get-email-content.
tool_descriptions.get-email-content: Retrieve the full body of a specific email
tool_descriptions.list-workspace-members: List members in the workspace with their details and team memberships
tool_descriptions.list-workspace-teams: List all teams in the workspace
tool_descriptions.whoami: Get information about the current user's identity and workspace membership
tool_descriptions.run-basic-report: Run aggregate reports on records or list entries, including totals, averages, and grouped breakdowns
tool_descriptions.query-particle-sql: Execute a read-only SQL query against your workspace data
